properties.name: transitions
properties.label: Transitions (action>to>nowFields>guard>process | ...); a now field marked @date is written as the day alone; a guard is terms joined by 'and', a term none(<entity> where <condition>) counting another record's rows

properties.name: records
properties.label: Other records a guard counts or a move sets, one line each (entity>form>table)

properties.name: thisKey
properties.label: The record's attribute that 'this' stands for in a condition (empty: its row id)

properties.name: related
properties.label: Columns set on a related record's rows after an applied move, one line each (action>entity>condition>column=moment|today|'word',...)

properties.name: audit
properties.label: History entries written after an applied move, one line each (action>form>table>column=source,column='word',...)

properties.name: notify
properties.label: Alerts written after an applied move, one line each (action>role:<id> or attr:<id>>template>form>table>column=source,...)

properties.name: refused
properties.label: History entries and alerts written after a refused move, one line each (audit> followed by a history entry's line, or notify> followed by an alert's line)

properties.name: targetField
properties.label: Target mode: the act's field naming the record moved (empty: the saved row is the record)

properties.name: targetKeyColumn
properties.label: Target mode: the record's column that field matches (empty: its row id)

properties.name: targetForm
properties.label: Target mode: the form the record is read through

properties.name: actForm
properties.label: Target mode: this act form's id

properties.name: actTable
properties.label: Target mode: this act form's table

properties.name: checkRoles
properties.label: Refuse an actor whose groups the move's mmEntityTransition row does not name

properties.name: reasonField
properties.label: Target mode: the act's field holding the move's reason

properties.name: copyFields
properties.label: Target mode: the act's fields copied onto the record (comma-separated)
